summary: The mirror image of Sand Offense's matchup against Trick Room — Kingambit's Dark-type moves alone threaten two of the three Trick Room representatives, and Farigiraf's Psychic is immune against Kingambit specifically, leaving Trick Room with only one clean answer.
keyFactors: Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave and Sucker Punch are both super effective against Sinistcha and Farigiraf — the same one-move, two-target pattern Sand Offense has against this archetype.

Charizard's Heat Wave and Weather Ball are super effective against Sinistcha too, and Garchomp's Earthquake and Rock Slide are both super effective against Incineroar — Sun's coverage reaches every Trick Room piece at least once.
Farigiraf's Psychic does nothing to Kingambit (Dark types are immune to Psychic moves), removing one of Trick Room's three attackers from this exchange entirely.
Incineroar's Flare Blitz is Trick Room's one solid answer, hitting Kingambit for double damage — but it's a single point of pressure against a much broader kit.
